ROK_2008_p79__title_2.ocr: Restricted Stock and Restricted Stock Units

ROK_2008_p79__paragraph_0.ocr:
We grant restricted stock to certain employees and previously granted restricted stock to our non-employee
directors. Beginning in 2008, our non-employee directors may elect to receive a portion of their compensation in
restricted stock units. Restrictions lapse over periods ranging from one to five years. We value restricted stock
and restricted stock units at the closing market value of our common stock on the date of grant.
